attributes.title: Echo Hawaii 2027
attributes.summary:
Echo Hawaii is the American Society of Echocardiography's winter course at the Fairmont Orchid on the Kohala Coast of the Big Island. The 2027 edition runs January 18 to 21. ASE aims it at adult cardiologists and critical care physicians, and it also lists cardiovascular surgeons, anesthesiologists, internists, fellows and sonographers among the expected audience.

ASE designates the course for up to 23.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with up to the same number of MOC or MOCA 2.0 points. The fee schedule has three steps. ASE-member physicians pay $1,099 through December 3, 2026, $1,199 through January 17, and $1,320 onsite. Nonmember physicians pay $1,545, $1,645 and $1,770. Fellows-in-training pay less, starting at $775 for members.

Hawaii residents can get 10 percent off full in-person registration, and U.S. military members can ask ASE for a discount code. Hotel details are on a separate ASE venue page.
